relationships.subject: contusive spinal cord injury
relationships.evidence_quote: Contusive SCI significantly increased Nav1.8 transient and resurgent sodium currents in the rat small DRG neurons.

relationships.subject: ZL0177
relationships.evidence_quote: ZL0177 simultaneously inhibits Nav1.8 I NaT and I NaR in ND7/23 cells in a concentration‐dependent manner.

relationships.subject: ZL0177
relationships.evidence_quote: We further show that ZL0177 greatly attenuates the hyperexcitability of small DRG neurons induced by SCI.

relationships.subject: FHF4A
relationships.evidence_quote: the I NaR can be fully reconstituted in a heterologous system by co‐expressing recombinant Nav1.8 and FHF4A (Fig. 6A and B ).

key_findings: Contusive SCI increases Nav1.8 transient and resurgent currents and the fraction of small DRG neurons with TTX-R resurgent current (46% to 94%), driving hyperexcitability; Nav1.9 current is unchanged.
ZL0177, which disrupts FHF binding to the sodium channel C-terminal tail, reduces Nav1.8/Nav1.9 currents and reverses SCI-induced hyperexcitability.
